model.prompt_context: This market resolves based on the closing price of Zcash (ZEC) for August 7, 2026, as reported in the "Close" column of the CoinGecko Zcash Price History page (coingecko.com/en/coins/zcash/historical_data) for the row dated 2026-08-07 (UTC daily close). Bands are inclusive of the lower bound and exclusive of the upper bound; for example, a close of exactly $492.50 resolves to the $492.50–$505.00 band.
